resolve_variable_import_module: resolve a variable from a module path string with optional type validation
resolve_class_load_class: resolve a class from a module path string with optional base class validation
build_missing_dependency_hint: build an actionable hint message when a Python module import fails
resolve_variable_type_check: resolve a variable from a module path and validate it matches an expected type
resolve_class_base_check: resolve a class from a module path and validate it is a subclass of a base class
